posts.text: Ferrari is expected to run a new floor in Austin, part of its fourth and final major upgrade of 2026. It aims for the same or more downforce with a less stiff set-up. Sidepod and bodywork changes may follow in Mexico. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=ferrari-austin-new-floor

Verstappen's helmet for Austin puts a cowboy hat on the lion. He and Hadjar will also wear white, vintage-style race suits; an all-white Red Bull livery is not confirmed. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=verstappen-texas-helmet-austin
